notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
With the last fix, I added a folder issue Steam couldn't handle. 
The funny part is, that I tried the functionality after the upload and everything worked fine. Steam is still a mystery to me. 
So - now the game works again.

It might be, that you have to reinstall the game again.
But the magical science upgrades and the statistics aren't affected by the reinstall. 

I'm very very sorry for acting that late (didn't see that there's a problem!). I was very busy the last weeks and on vacation as well. 

Have fun while playing the game now!
Greetings,
IsaVII

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Really - why nobody told me all that time? Because of existent data on my computer, I never noticed this issue: the story progress hasn't been saved. 
So, this problem is fixed now :) 
I'm sorry for all trouble with this part!  But now you can enjoy playing it during multiple sessions. 
Save the unicorns!

notes.title: Update 1 _ Uniboom
notes.content:
This is the first update of Uniboom. I created the game during my studies, so it's not a surprise that there are bugs in it. 

- fixed text speed problem 
  The text should continue now after sticking at one letter. 
  This occurred in the intro and levels and prevent players from playing
